ValidationRule.description: Do not allow edits to Closed Opportunities to be modified except by Admin or Looker Integration which updates First Opp product Live and Gross Margin.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "A - RevOps", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", NOT(ISBLANK (Date_100__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(Date_100__c)) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not update a Closed Opportunity. If you need a correction made, please submit a Flywire Ticket via OKTA for your Salesforce Administrator and include the link to this Opportunity.
